cohort: 1728 hepatitis B surface antigen (HBsAg)-positive women and 1497 HBsAg-negative women
finding: Maternal HBsAg carriage was associated with several adverse pregnancy outcomes, including pregnancy-induced hypertension, fetal distress, cesarean delivery, and macrosomia.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more common in HBsAg-positive women.
